    AI Overview
    Watch the 2026 Boston Marathon on April 20th via ESPN2 (9 a.m.–12:30 p.m. ET) or stream on ESPN+, fuboTV, and the Very Local app. Local coverage is on WCVB Channel 5. To track runners, download the official B.A.A. Racing App. Top viewing spots include the Wellesley Scream Tunnel and Heartbreak Hill. 
    TV and Streaming Options 
    • National (USA): ESPN2 (9 a.m. – 12:30 p.m. ET) and ESPN+ (4 a.m. – 4 p.m. ET).
    • Local (New England): WCVB Channel 5 (all-day coverage) and other Hearst stations.
    • Streaming: fuboTV (free trial) and the Very Local app. 
    Tracking Runners 
    • B.A.A. Racing App: Download the free app on iOS or Android for live leaderboards, athlete tracking, and alerts. 
    In-Person Spectating 
    • Top Spots: The Wellesley Scream Tunnel (halfway point) and Heartbreak Hill in Newton are high-energy locations.
    • Transportation: Take the MBTA Green Line, though expect detours and increased ridership.
    • Route Map: Review the official course map. 
    International Viewing 
    • Check local sports networks or visit the official Boston Marathon website.
